**Phone calls, IVRs and meetings as BPMN processes on the Sutra engine — the first release.**

**2026-10-26.** sutra-voice 0.6.0 adds telephony and video to the
[Sutra workflow engine](https://github.com/startr-trade/sutra): a `voip` transport that lets a BPMN
flow answer a number, hear the caller one utterance at a time, speak back, take DTMF, transfer,
hang up and place calls of its own, and a WebRTC media worker that lets a flow sit in on a video
meeting, record it, transcribe it and analyse it through the engine's `llm` channels.

**It requires engine v0.6.0.** The `engine/` submodule pins the engine's `v0.6.0` release, and the
`sutra-voice` image is built from it. Versions are aligned by minor: sutra-voice 0.6.x runs on
engine 0.6.x, each with its own patch releases.

The book is at **[voice.sutra.startr.trade](https://voice.sutra.startr.trade)**: a quick start,
the architecture, a guide per component and a walkthrough per example, each of which runs on your
own machine against a bundled stub model server, with no provider key needed. Everything about
BPMN itself is in the [Sutra book](https://sutra.startr.trade/).

## Preview in this release

**Everything here is a preview: voice calls, IVR, meetings and video.** The channel keys, the
media-stream protocol, the `voip://` operations and the recording format may still change in a
minor release. Use 0.6 to build and evaluate flows; pin the image by digest if you deploy it.

## Supported gateways and media servers

| | Supported in 0.6 | Checked against |
|---|---|---|
| PBX | **rustpbx** — inbound calls through its IVR app, call control (originate, transfer, hang-up) over its RWI socket | rustpbx 0.5.1 |
| SFU | **LiveKit** — through the WebRTC worker, one tagged media stream per meeting | LiveKit server v1.13.9 |
| Any other gateway | the **media-stream protocol** (a WebSocket of PCM or G.711 frames plus small control frames) is the whole interface; call control needs a gateway-specific adapter | — |

Asterisk and FreeSWITCH adapters are on the [roadmap](https://voice.sutra.startr.trade/roadmap.html).

## What is in it

- **The `voip` transport** — a media WebSocket on the engine's HTTP listener, energy-VAD turns,
  real-time paced playback with barge-in, DTMF, number binding, outbound calls behind an allow-list
  that refuses everything by default, rate limits and premium-rate blocking.
- **Listen-only calls and meetings** — a flow joins a conference, records it (streamed to an
  S3-compatible object store in sealed one-second chunks, recoverable after a crash, referenced by
  hash from the audit trail and never embedded in it), transcribes it live and writes minutes.
- **Recording behind consent** — `record: after-consent` starts a recording only once an
  announcement marked as the consent prompt has played to the end.
- **The WebRTC worker** — joins a LiveKit room as a visibly labelled participant and streams each
  participant's audio and sampled video to the engine, so transcription is attributed per speaker.
- **Segment analysis** — a meeting is cut into segments in the object store that a flow hands to a
  model by reference, with staff analysis refused unless a deployment allows it explicitly.
- **Four examples**: `ivr-dtmf` (a DTMF menu with a decision table, no model), `voice-assistant`,
  `meeting-assistant` and `video-meeting-assistant`, each with a local compose stack.

## Images

Both images are multi-arch (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64), signed with cosign (keyless), and carry
SLSA provenance and an SPDX SBOM attestation. Each SBOM is also attached to this release.

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/startr-trade/sutra-voice:0.6.0
docker pull ghcr.io/startr-trade/sutra-webrtc-worker:0.6.0

cosign verify ghcr.io/startr-trade/sutra-voice:0.6.0 \
  --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/startr-trade/sutra-voice/\.github/workflows/release\.yml@' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

`sutra-voice` is the Sutra engine's default bundle with the `voip` transport linked in; it runs
exactly like the engine image, plus the transport's `SUTRA_VOIP_*` settings. The public engine
image does not include `voip`. `sutra-webrtc-worker` also carries `sutra-webrtc-participant`, a
scripted participant for tests and demos.

The full list of changes is in the
[changelog](https://github.com/startr-trade/sutra-voice/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
